memory_update.text: VECO should be promoted in the optical_connectivity_epitaxy_tools node as a direct underfollowed equipment candidate because its 2026 InP laser equipment order announcement is strong node-specific evidence.
AXTI is a high-relevance but messy substrate-layer candidate; keep it in Layer 1 as a hypothesis due to InP datacenter exposure and export-permit/geography risks.

Tower Semiconductor maps to the silicon-photonics foundry branch of the node rather than to compound-semiconductor substrate supply; its relevance depends on whether AI optical modules and photonic integrated circuits ramp materially on its SiPho platform.
Need a follow-up pass on MACOM, Lumentum, Fabrinet, Semtech, Viavi, and possible OTC/foreign ADRs such as Aixtron and IQE to complete the optical laser, assembly, testing, and epitaxy-tool universe.

node: Optical connectivity, lasers, compound-semiconductor epitaxy, and epitaxy equipment
summary: Expanded the universe around the upstream optical-connectivity chokepoint. The most relevant underfollowed lane is not the obvious optical-module assemblers alone, but the chain of InP laser capacity, silicon-photonics foundry capacity, compound-semiconductor substrates, and epitaxy/MOCVD tools. Four US-listed or US-traded candidates were selected: one reference laser/platform leader, and three less obvious node exposures across equipment, substrates, and silicon-photonics foundry capacity. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
